methodology.missing_data: Unknown conditions remain pending; they are never counted as pass.
methodology.buffett: The interest watchlist requires ROIC >=12% for the latest three consecutive fiscal years (ROE >=10% for financials) and at least one true condition from the original seven. Non-financial companies with cash above 50% of market cap are excluded. The legacy strict candidate still requires all seven plus normalized FCF yield >=5%.
methodology.quality: All quality conditions must pass, then eligible stocks are ranked by GP/A and the top 25 are selected as an equal-weight basket.

methodology.cagr: positive start and end values over fiscal-year span
methodology.eps_cagr: owners' net income per distributed share at period endpoints; issued shares are the fallback denominator; when endpoint share counts differ by more than 2x, owners' net income CAGR is used to avoid stock-split distortion

valuation.note: FCF yield uses a 10-year average when complete, otherwise a complete recent 3-year average. Non-financial companies with cash above 50% of market cap fail the excess-cash gate.

valuation.note: FCF yield uses a 10-year average when complete, otherwise a complete recent 3-year average. Non-financial companies with cash above 50% of market cap fail the excess-cash gate.
